description: Verify that every question cites a file and symbol that really exist (strict, then fair: folder-less paths and Class::method). A predict question must also carry `expected`, quoting in backticks code that is really in the cited file. Ask the user only the questions in `kept`. With `base`, a question must also cite a file changed since that git ref.

base.description: Git ref for pull-request questions, e.g. main

expected.description: Predict questions only: the result worked out from the cited code, quoting in backticks the line(s) it relies on

file.description: Repo-relative path of the cited file

fromTest.description: Predict questions from test_cases: keep this as given

symbol.description: Function, class or other name the question is about

text.description: The question as you will ask it

name: check_questions
title: Check question citations
